instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to the smallest option available.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated Chrome menu -> Settings -> Appearance -> Font size dropdown and selected 'Very large' in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome menu, navigate to Settings, find Appearance section, interact with font size dropdown, select specific options.
metadata.task_rationale: Reverse of original task: set font size to smallest instead of largest. Same navigation pattern, different target value.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome Appearance settings and selecting 'Very small' from the font size dropdown. Evaluator uses official check_font_size metric with chrome_font_size getter, expecting a value <= 10 (Very small = 9).

scoring_breakdown.font_size: 1.0 - Font size set to Very small (value <= 10)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter chrome_font_size correctly reads Chrome's Preferences JSON file from disk to extract default_font_size value.
Postconfig properly kills and relaunches Chrome to flush Preferences to disk before getter reads it.
Metric check_font_size with range rule (0 < x < 10) correctly identifies 'Very small' font size (value=9) and rejects all other options (12, 16, 20, 24).
Single-requirement instruction fully covered by single evaluator check.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] and rule['min']/rule['max'] properly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider using an exact value check (type='value', value=9) instead of a range check, to be more precise about the expected 'Very small' font size.
